# Upgrade VS Agent

Three version numbers move independently: the Verana release (v4), the Admin API version (`/v2`), and the agent's own version (2.0.0 and following). An agent 2.x implements Verana v4 and Admin API v2; a breaking change to the API would bump its prefix.

## Procedure

1. Read the release notes of the new version in the [vs-agent repository](https://github.com/verana-labs/vs-agent/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).
2. Back up (database, volume).
3. Change the image tag (`VS_AGENT_VERSION` in Compose, `image.tag` and chart `--version` with Helm) and roll. The agent migrates its storage at start when the release requires it.
4. Readiness `200`, `info` shows the new version and the same DID, resolve returns trusted.

## Roll back

Restore the backup from before the upgrade and roll the previous tag. A storage migration is not always reversible; the release notes say so.
